# [TASK] Audit the 5 CI and build bugs

## Task
Audit the 5 CI and build bugs with `/audit-artifacts`: shape, voice, truth, proof.

Bugs in continuous integration, the Gradle build and local test runs.

Scope: #107, #109, #161, #174, #250.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bug #107 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #109 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #161 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #174 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree
- [ ] Bug #250 audited: matches the bug template, meets the writing standard, its fix and regression criteria each name a proof, and severity, priority label and body agree

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Bugs have no parent section by design. Do not add one.

A bug's "Fixed and verified live" criterion is the one most likely to rest
on a date. Replace it with the regression test that would catch the bug
coming back, and write that test if it does not exist.
